title: Projective-resolution Ext cocycles and their derived roof formulas
statement: Let C be an abelian category with Ext and a derived category [def-pc-ext, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], X,Y objects, P a projective resolution of X, and n a natural number. There is an equivalence Ext(X,Y,n) with degree-n Hom-complex cohomology classes from P.cochainComplex to Y[0]. For a cocycle c, the derived morphism of the inverse equivalence on [c] is the composite of the inverse of Q(P.pi-prime) with Q(Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm c), conjugated by the standard singleFunctorIsoCompQ identifications. Every Ext class is P.extMk(a,n+1,rfl,ha) for a:P_n to Y with d_(n+1,n) followed by a zero. extEquivCohomologyClass_extMk identifies its class with Cocycle.toSingleMk of the transported a, and extMk_hom gives exactly the same roof formula for this cocycle.
